## Thank you all for your patience.

I'm sorry that I haven't been able to reach out sooner and share our thinking with you. Part of the reason is that we have been concentrating on the development of V2.7.0 — an important version we are preparing for you. The other is that we wanted to see the situation more clearly and think it through more thoroughly before responding, so as not to repeat what happened before: a hasty statement followed by a hurried reversal, which ended up causing even greater problems.

## Our commitment

In V2.6.0 we introduced new difficulties and rewards for the D-Effect Zone. The intent behind that change was to offer a fresh challenge without affecting the rewards you were already able to obtain.
Alongside it, we made a commitment: the core rewards are achievable without Over-Exaltation, without Absolute Axiom, and without Emergency Gnosis. We do not use these additional layers as the baseline for stage balance. And if what actually happens does not match that expectation, we will make adjustments.

## The adjustments coming

Among all the feedback we received, one item needs to be addressed first: the difficulty curve leading into Hard is far too steep, which makes the experience at that tier drop off sharply.
So, starting next rotation:
- Hard — enemy HP reduced by roughly 20%–50%, and damage by roughly 7%–11%, with Hard 5 receiving the largest reduction.

In the current version, we have in fact seen Nightmare cleared without relying on Over-Exaltation, Absolute Axiom or Emergency Gnosis — consistent with the standard we designed against in internal testing. But for many Keepers, that standard may still sit too close to the edge. Loosening it somewhat is better for everyone.
So, also starting next rotation:
- Nightmare — enemy HP reduced by roughly 5%–15%, so that more of you have a chance at the newly added Silver rewards.

## A sincere apology

Whatever the reasons behind it, a breakdown in communication is my failure.
Please allow me to offer you my sincere apologies.
We will continue to do everything we can to honour every commitment we have made to you, as we always have.

100 Ethereal Cores will be sent to your in-game mail shortly.

May the Silver Key guide the way.

# 关于融灾禁区的调整说明

## 大家久等了！
    
    很抱歉这段时间没能及时与各位沟通，说明我们的想法。一方面，我们正在集中精力为大家准备 V2.7.0 这一重要版本的研发；另一方面，我们也希望把情况看得更清楚、想得更透彻再作回应——避免重蹈此前"仓促表态、又匆忙撤回"的覆辙，那反而带来了更大的问题。
    
## 我们的承诺
    
    V2.6.0 中，我们新增了融灾禁区的难度与奖励。这项调整的本意，是在不影响大家原有可获取奖励的前提下，提供一份新的挑战。 同时我们承诺：核心奖励无需超限爆发、最终法则与应急灵知体即可达成，我们不会以这些额外内容作为关卡平衡的设计基准。如果实际情况与这一预期不符，我们会做出调整。

## 即将到来的调整
    
    在收到的诸多反馈中，有一项需要优先处理：困难难度的成长梯度过于陡峭，导致这一档位的体验落差非常大。
    因此，自下期起：困难难度敌人生命值下调约 20%~50%，伤害下调约 7%~11%，其中困难 5 的降幅最大。
    
    当前版本中，我们确实看到了不依赖超限爆发、最终法则与应急灵知体的噩梦通关记录，这与我们内部测试的设计标准一致。但对许多守密人而言，这个标准或许仍然过于极限——适当放宽，对所有人都更好。
    因此，自下期起：噩梦难度敌人生命值下调约 5%~15%，让更多人有机会拿到新增的银芯奖励。
    
## 诚挚的歉意

    不管出于什么原因，沟通中断，终究是我的失职。
    在此，请允许我向各位诚挚致歉。
    我们会继续竭尽全力兑现我们做出的每一个承诺，一如既往。

    100 个空幻之芯稍后将发送至各位的邮箱。

愿银钥指引前路。
